notablePrerequisites: You have an enchantment card in hand with the mana to cast it.
description:
Cast any enchantment by paying its mana cost.
When the enchantment enters the bttlefield, Protean Thaumaturge and Ondu Spiritdancer triggers.
Resolve the Protean Thaumaturge trigger, causing it to become a copy of Ondu Spiritdancer while keeping its ability.
Resolve the Ondu Spiritdancer trigger, creating a token copy of the enchantment that was cast.
When the enchantment enters the battlefield, Protean Thaumaturge triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, causing it to become a copy of Ondu Spiritdancer while keeping its ability.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a token copy of the enchantment that was cast.
Repeat from step 5.
